nodes.label: Restaurant Dining Scene - Shared Plates
nodes.description: A close-up, candid dining photograph showing multiple guests sharing several dishes at a dark marble-topped restaurant table. Two sets of hands are visible — one holding a fork lifting a piece of saucy, breaded food from a patterned ceramic plate, the other reaching in with a utensil. The table holds at least four distinct dishes: a patterned plate with a salad dressed in crumbled white cheese and sauce, a bowl of sauced and tossed bites garnished with shredded vegetables, a metal basket of fried pieces with lemon and dipping sauce on a wooden board, and a shallow bowl of fried bites in the foreground. Wine glasses (red and white) and a water glass are visible in the soft background. The mood is warm, lively, and intimate — evoking a convivial group dining experience. Visual style is editorial food photography with shallow depth of field, natural-leaning light, and muted warm tones. Purpose on a restaurant website: communicates a social, shareable dining culture and menu variety.

nodes.label: Shared Dining Table with Multiple Appetizer Plates
nodes.description: A top-down angled shot of a dark marble restaurant table set for a group dining experience. Multiple small plates and shared dishes are spread across the surface: a wire fry basket on a wooden tray holding golden fried croquettes or arancini with lemon wedges, accompanied by two dipping sauces; a striped ceramic plate with crispy fried pieces garnished with microgreens and a light sauce; a teal ceramic plate with a fried or baked item; and a partially eaten dish in a wide bowl. Red wine and water glasses are visible in the background, and diners' hands are seen reaching in, conveying an active, communal meal in progress. The mood is warm, social, and upscale-casual. Visual style is editorial food photography with shallow depth of field and moody low-key lighting. Purpose on restaurant website: showcases the shared-plates dining concept, appetizer variety, and lively group atmosphere to attract diners seeking a sociable fine-casual experience.

nodes.label: Interior Dining Area with Graffiti Mural
nodes.description: Interior shot of The District Tapas & Bar restaurant dining area featuring a prominent graffiti-style mural on the white wall. The mural displays the restaurant name 'The District' in bold teal/turquoise graffiti lettering with the tagline 'Tapas x Bar' beneath it. The artwork includes colourful cartoon-style illustrations: a Sydney Harbour Bridge silhouette, stylised trees with sunglasses, a guitar, spray cans, a boombox, a frog, a penguin character, and various urban/pop-art motifs rendered in pink, teal, black, and green. The foreground shows dark leather booth seating and light wood dining tables set with menus and small table lamps. The ceiling is painted black. The overall mood is vibrant, urban, and youthful with a street-art aesthetic that communicates a casual-cool brand identity.

The building is a red-brick structure with illuminated upper-floor windows. The mood is vibrant and inviting, contrasting the dark night with warm amber interior lighting.
